name: linkedin-scheduler
description: Write LinkedIn posts in Markdown, push, and they publish on time. Runs on your own Cloudflare account.

LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Your LinkedIn access token with the `w_member_social` scope. Get it in 2 minutes with LinkedIn's Token Generator: https://github.com/cjdotdev/linkedin-scheduler/blob/main/docs/linkedin-setup.md. It lets this Worker post on your profile: it stays on your Cloudflare account.

LINKEDIN_TOKEN_EXPIRES.description: The day the token expires, as `YYYY-MM-DD`: about 60 days after you generated it. `/status` warns 7 days before.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: A long random string that protects `/status` and `/check`, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 24`. Keep a copy.

DRY_RUN.description: `0` publishes for real. `1` only logs what would be posted (useful for a first test).
